<translate>
The '''Super armor sets''' are the 31 character-themed sets whose pattern is painted on a '''Blank Pattern (Super)'''. They only differ in looks: every set uses the Kikono armor material and gives the same protection.
</translate>

<translate>
== Crafting a set ==

# Craft a Blank Pattern (Super): <code>C B C / P W P / C B C</code>, where C is Cyan Wool, B is a Blank Pattern (Z), P is Paper and W is White Wool.
# Paint the set's pattern on it at the '''Pattern Station'''.
# Assemble each piece at '''Dr. Kikono's Station''' with the pattern, Kikono Cloth, Kikono String and the matching iron armor piece. Each piece costs 1,000 Star Energy.

See [[Special:MyLanguage/Armor|Armor]] for the full process, the recipes and how armor adds to your defense.
</translate>

<translate>
